name: @sos-2/cost-policy
description: SOS 2.0 Cost + Reliability policy contracts (Work Order P14): task concurrency/cost budgets (typed ALLOW / BUDGET_EXCEEDED denial / ACCOUNTING_UNKNOWN when accounting is incomplete — never silently guessed), rate limiting over action/executor invocations (typed limit policies with deterministic reference limiter and retry-after backoff hints), provider health with honest UNKNOWN during outage windows (the P7 truthful-stale discipline; no fabricated health), dead-letter/retry handling with bounded retry/backoff then ASK (never silent drop, never infinite retry) and abuse containment (a task exhibiting abuse signatures is suspended pending ASK — the suspension is observed evidence, not silent termination). Deterministic reference implementations with injectable seams; real billing systems, rate-limit infrastructure and provider status pages attach later as adapters without contract change. Declares ZERO dependencies (lockfile byte-identity rule, the P3 precedent); the test toolchain is borrowed at run time from the frozen W17 adversarial suite.
